Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated two different women named “Pauline of Württemberg.” Prince Nikolaus Wilhelm’s mother was Princess Pauline Friederike Marie of Württemberg (1810–1856), a German princess from Württemberg, but the Planner attributed details of Pauline Therese of Württemberg (1800–1873), Queen of Württemberg, who was born in Riga (Russian Empire). This misidentification led to the incorrect conclusion that the mother’s country of origin was Russia rather than Württemberg/Germany.
